title: Schwarzsee Kitzbühel
highlights: One of the warmest and most picturesque moor lakes in the Kitzbühel Alps
Breathtaking views of the prominent rocky crest of the Wilder Kaiser
Municipal lido with extensive sunbathing lawns and electric boat rentals
Popular walking path circling the scenic protected lakeside
kurzbeschreibung: Schwarzsee between Kitzbühel and Reith is a warm moor lake offering postcard views of the Wilder Kaiser.
beschreibung:
Moor Gem with Kaiser Panorama

The Schwarzsee lies picturesquely between Kitzbühel and Reith at an altitude of 762 meters. Due to its high peat content, the lake warms up very quickly in early summer, ranking among the warmest and healthiest bathing lakes in all of Tirol.

Leisure Fun in Every Season

The municipal open-air bath offers modern piers, sunbathing lawns, a diving tower, and a lakeside bistro. Romantic electric and rowing boats invite visitors to take a peaceful glide across the dark waters reflecting the rugged crags of the Wilder Kaiser. A level lakeside walking path provides a wonderfully relaxing circuit.
